name: elvira
label: Elvira
description: Mistress of the Dark. Purple and black, a high-contrast serif, soft edges, and a horror host who is enjoying herself at the group's expense and never at any one person's.

og_image_alt: Night of a Thousand Pixels 2026, styled as a late-night horror host's title card: orchid purple and hot pink on black.

copy.site.title: A Thousand Pixels After Dark
copy.site.tagline: Thirty friends, two picks each, one survivor, and me. Unpleasant dreams.
copy.quota.barred: You're on the list to rank this year, but not to put anything on the slab.
copy.quota.at_limit: That's all {count} spent, and no, you can't have another.
copy.home.lead: Thirty-odd friends, two picks each, and one gloriously vindictive instant-runoff count that decides what everybody's watching. Democracy, but with a body count.
copy.home.notice.body: I'm still airing the place out. Submissions open in early October, the link drops in the group chat, and you will not be able to pretend you missed it.
copy.home.steps.heading: How exactly one of you gets your way
copy.home.step1.title: Offer something up
copy.home.step1.body: Early October. Sign in and put up to two films on the slab. A trailer link helps everybody else decide, and helps you pretend you had a reason.
copy.home.step2.title: Rank them
copy.home.step2.body: Pick your top three, in order. It's instant-runoff, so a second choice isn't a wasted one — it's the knife you keep behind your back for the next round.
copy.home.step3.title: Watch
copy.home.step3.body: Movie night. The survivor goes up on the screen, everybody who lost gets to be gracious about it, and the whole mess joins every year before it in the archive.
copy.home.archive.heading: Previous victims
copy.home.archive.empty: Nothing to gawk at yet. Old seasons move in as they're exhumed, and then they stay put.
copy.slate.count.heading: {count} on the slab
copy.slate.hidden.body: This list includes the ones that were quietly withdrawn, marked as such. Nobody else gets to see them. Aren't you special.
copy.slate.empty.heading: Thirty of you. Nobody's moved.
copy.slate.empty.body: Every year starts exactly like this — an empty slab and thirty people waiting for somebody else to be the one with taste. Whoever goes first sets the tone. Whoever goes second gets to play it safe. Your choice, darling.
copy.slate.actions.signin: Sign in and pick a side
copy.slate.actions.signin_note: Anyone can look. Only this year's coven gets to touch.
copy.season.state.draft.label: Not yet
copy.season.state.draft.summary: This year hasn't started. The link drops in the group chat the moment it does, and not a minute before.
copy.season.state.submitting.label: The slab is open
copy.season.state.submitting.summary: Put something up. Ranking starts the second submissions close, and after that it's out of your hands and into everybody else's.
copy.season.state.voting.label: Ranking open
copy.season.state.voting.summary: Submissions are closed. Rank your top three — the second choice is the one that does the damage.
copy.season.state.locked.label: Finished
copy.season.state.locked.summary: This one's over, buried, and not coming back.
copy.outcome.winner.body: {title}. The rest of you were outvoted by your own friends, and will now be gracious about it — which I'm told is a thing people can be.
copy.outcome.tied.body: The last round came out perfectly level, so nothing won outright. Thirty people, one count, and you still couldn't agree on anything. I have never been prouder.
copy.movie.trailer.title: Trailer: {title}
copy.submit.heading: Offer something up
copy.submit.lead: A title is all I need. A trailer link and one line about why you picked it is what makes somebody else rank it first, and getting somebody else to rank it first is the entire game.
copy.submit.existing.heading: {count} from you so far
copy.submit.errors.heading: {count} to fix before I let this through.
copy.submit.field.title.label: Title
copy.submit.field.title.hint: The name of the picture. It's the one thing I can't guess.
copy.submit.field.year.label: Year
copy.submit.field.year.hint: Optional, four digits. It settles which remake you meant, and there is always a remake.
copy.submit.field.trailer.label: Trailer link
copy.submit.field.trailer.hint: Optional. A YouTube link plays right here on the slab; anything else just becomes a link.
copy.submit.field.description.label: Why this one
copy.submit.field.description.hint: Optional, and the only part anyone actually reads. One good sentence beats three dull ones.
copy.submit.blocked.locked.heading: That one's over and buried
copy.submit.blocked.locked.body: {season} is in the archive, and an archived year doesn't budge. Its slate is what it is. Whatever you were about to suggest, you're a year late.
copy.submit.blocked.voting.heading: The slab is closed
copy.submit.blocked.voting.body: Submissions are done — everything that made it is out there being judged, mostly unfairly. Ranking decides the rest now.
copy.submit.blocked.draft.heading: Not yet
copy.submit.blocked.draft.body_dated: The slab opens on {date}. The link drops in the group chat, and you'll act surprised.
copy.submit.blocked.draft.body_undated: Nobody's settled on dates yet. The link drops in the group chat the moment somebody does.
copy.submit.blocked.barred.heading: You're here to judge, not to offer
copy.submit.blocked.barred.body: {quota} That's a setting on your name rather than something you used up, so say something in the group chat if it looks wrong — I won't tell anyone you asked.
copy.submit.blocked.at_limit.heading: That's your two. Put it down.
copy.submit.blocked.at_limit.body_dated: {quota} They're below, and at least one of them is genuinely good. Ranking opens on {date}, and then everybody gets to tell you which one.
copy.submit.blocked.at_limit.body_undated: {quota} They're below, and at least one of them is genuinely good. Ranking opens once submissions close, and then everybody gets to tell you which one.
copy.submit.blocked.outsider.heading: This part's for the coven
copy.submit.blocked.outsider.body: The slab is public to look at and not to touch. If you're on this year's list, sign in with the account you gave us. If you're not, ask in the group chat — somebody will vouch for you.
copy.submit.blocked.unknown.heading: Not right now, darling
copy.submit.blocked.unknown.body: I'm not taking your submission at the moment and I'd rather not get into it. The slab is still there to read, and the group chat is the fastest way to find out why.
copy.error.404.heading: There's nothing here
copy.error.404.body: The link might be out of date, or a season that hasn't crawled out yet. Nothing is broken — there is simply nothing at this address, which is somehow worse.
copy.error.500.heading: Well, that was ugly
copy.error.500.body: The server hit an error and gave up on this page entirely. It has been written down. Try again in a minute, and make a scene in the group chat if it keeps happening.
copy.error.405.heading: You can't do that here
copy.error.405.body: The page exists, just not for the kind of request that turned up. Usually that means a stale form, or a submission you reloaded.
